'''''Legacy of the Jedi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]]. The story explores four generations of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], including [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. It was published by [[Scholastic]] in [[August]] [[2003]] as part of the [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].
